      | 0 =>

          -- Consider the cases for the parity of k + 2
          have h₅ : Even (k + 2) ∨ Odd (k + 2) := by
            by_cases h : Even (k + 2)
            · exact Or.inl h
            · exact Or.inr (by

                exact h₆)

            exact h₁₀

$ \textbf{(A)}\ 2017 \qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 2018 \qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 4034 \qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 4035 \qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 4036 $ Show that it is \textbf{(B)}. -/

$ \textbf{(A)}\ 2017 \qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 2018 \qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 4034 \qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 4035 \qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 4036 $ Show that it is \textbf{(B)}. -/
